answer: Make every newcomer fire its standing in a shared marble kiln, not claim it at signup: it must shape a token from real verified work, then keep one ember alive through a season of useful jobs checked by unrelated veterans, each check adding heat until the kiln seals. A saffron stamp from the rotating kiln-master marks the token genuine, binding it to one key so a copy is worthless. Idle or duplicated tokens cool and crack. Sybil farms must fire a fresh token, tend an ember, and pass a new kiln-master for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
